Global exception filter middleware. Registers filters that transform exceptions into HTTP responses, similar to ASP.NET's IExceptionFilter pattern.Return global error filter options with safe defaults.Build an ExceptionFilter with a name, handler, and optional priority.Return the built-in filter mapping ValueError to a 400 response.Return the built-in filter mapping KeyError to a 400 response.Return the built-in filter mapping IOError to a 502 response.Return the built-in filter mapping OSError to a 503 response.Return the built-in filter mapping JsonParsingError to a 400 response.Return the five built-in exception filters; call once at startup.Middleware routing caught exceptions to the configured filters.Middleware overload built directly from a sequence of filters.Middleware with all built-in filters plus the given extraFilters.

Imports

common, logger

Types

ExceptionFilter = object
  name*: string
  priority*: int             ## Higher priority values are evaluated first (default 0).
  exceptionType*: string
  handler*: ExceptionFilterProc
ExceptionFilterProc = proc (err: ref Exception; req: Req; res: Res): bool {.
    closure.}
Exception filter handler. Returns true when the filter claims the error. A handler returning true MUST have written and finalized the response (e.g. via res.json or res.send); the middleware then stops processing and does not send any further response. res.finished is not used as the claim signal because a write can be dropped as a late write (disconnected client) while still leaving the handler's chosen status authoritative. 
GlobalErrorFilterOptions = object
  filters*: seq[ExceptionFilter]
  fallbackStatusCode*: int
  logUnhandled*: bool
